name: Jin Shouzen
source:
Born on December 25, 1968, currently 31 years old (as of 1999).
After the bubble economy burst, he returned to China to take care of his sick [url=https://vndb.org/c93440]uncle[/url]. Since then, he hasn't visited Japan again, but he has kept in contact with [url=https://vndb.org/c159275]Shiori[/url]. 
The small restaurant that he ran in his hometown was in a business slump and had to close down. 
After the unexpected meeting with [url=https://vndb.org/c159276]Kou Shamo[/url], he decided to come to Japan once more.
